subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce that our Annual Employee Appreciation Day is just around the corner! We will be hosting a fun-filled event with games, food, and awards to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. Please mark your calendars for Friday, August 20th, and stay tuned for more details. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
